common.unavailableTitle: This is not available right now
common.unavailableBody: We could not reach your record. Nothing you typed has been lost — try again in a moment.

vitals.title: Log a reading
vitals.subtitle: A measurement you took yourself
vitals.notClinicalBody: Anything you log here is marked as recorded by you. It is kept separate from measurements taken at a facility, and a health worker can tell the two apart.
vitals.notePlaceholder: e.g. sitting, after five minutes of rest
vitals.savedBody: {{value}} {{unit}} is now in your own log, marked as recorded by you.
vitals.refusedBody: Nothing was saved. Here is what needs fixing:
vitals.yourLogEmptyTitle: You have not logged anything yet
vitals.yourLogEmptyBody: Readings you take at home appear here, kept separate from what a facility measured.
vitals.facilitySubtitle: Taken by health staff or a laboratory
vitals.provenanceFacilityBody: Taken by health staff during a visit.
vitals.provenanceLabBody: Produced by a laboratory from a sample.
vitals.facilityEmptyBody: Readings taken during a visit will appear here. Nothing is shown until one is recorded.
vitals.voidBody: It stays in your history as removed, so nothing quietly disappears from your record. You can log a corrected reading afterwards.
vitals.voidedBody: It no longer counts as a current reading.

referralRequest.title: Ask for a referral
referralRequest.subtitle: A clinician reviews this before anything happens
referralRequest.notAReferralTitle: This is a request, not a referral
referralRequest.openCtaSubtitle: Tell a clinician why you think you need to see a specialist
referralRequest.specialtyLabel: Who would you like to see?
referralRequest.specialtyHint: Pick the closest one, or describe it in your own words.
referralRequest.reasonLabel: Why do you think you need this?
referralRequest.reasonHint: What you are feeling, and what has changed. A clinician reads this.
referralRequest.reasonPlaceholder: Describe your symptoms and how long you have had them
referralRequest.reasonTooShort: Please write a little more, so a clinician can understand.
referralRequest.durationLabel: How long has this been going on?
referralRequest.urgencyLabel: How urgent does it feel to you?
referralRequest.phoneLabel: A number to reach you on
referralRequest.noteLabel: Anything else a clinician should know?
referralRequest.sentBody: Your request ({{reference}}) is with a clinician. You have not been referred yet — you will see the outcome in your referrals.
referralRequest.refusedBody: Nothing was sent. Here is what needs fixing:
referralRequest.listSubtitle: Requests you sent. These are not referrals.
referralRequest.emptyCalloutBody: You cannot write a referral yourself — but you can ask for one, and a clinician will decide.
referralRequest.emptyTitle: You have not asked for a referral
referralRequest.emptyBody: If you think you need to see a specialist, you can ask a clinician to consider it.
referralRequest.urgencyCaveatTitle: How urgent it feels to you
referralRequest.withdrawBody: It stays in your history as withdrawn. A clinician may already have read it. You can send a new request later.
referralRequest.withdrawnBody: Nothing further will happen with it.
